caption: Average performance of different models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 tests. This is the average score (with maximum score 150) over the four tests on 100 runs with temperature t=0.5. We chose t = 0.5 to follow simple-evals <cit.>. Error bars are 2 of the estimate. On competition math, scores well above its weight-class even compared to non–open-weight models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores of various AI models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 tests, with the y-axis representing the average score on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 90, labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5)”. The x-axis lists the model names in a left-to-right sequence: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14B-Instruct, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72B-Instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4. Each model is represented by two adjacent bars: a light blue bar for the “Large model” and a dark blue bar for the “Small model”, as indicated by the legend. The approximate values for each bar are: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct (Large: 66.4, Small: 74.8), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Large: 74.8, Small: 77.4), Qwen 2.5 14B-Instruct (Large: 77.9, Small: 78.2), GPT-4o (Large: 78.2, Small: 78.7), GPT-4o-mini (Large: 78.7, Small: 81.6), Qwen 2.5 72B-Instruct (Large: 81.6, Small: 89.8), Gemini Flash 1.5 (Large: 89.8, Small: 91.8), and phi-4 (Large: 91.8, Small: 91.8). The bars are not sorted, and all bars are presented with error bars indicating two standard deviations of the estimate, though the specific error bar lengths are not labeled. The phi-4 model shows the highest performance, with its large and small variants both scoring 91.8. The chart visually emphasizes the phi-4 model’s performance with its position at the far right and its high score, while the Llama-3.3 70B Instruct model shows the lowest score among the large models at 66.4.
